content_zh:
听到虾仁蒸蛋，欢欢顿时眼前一亮，心情也美好了起来，“哥哥，你要给我做一辈子的虾仁蒸蛋。”
“好！”
吃完早餐后，宁宁洗了碗，收拾完厨房，又打扫了整个屋子，就和欢欢一起出门采购去了。许静一个星期没有去超市了，冰箱很干净，令宁宁很嫌弃。
宁宁和欢欢刚出门，许静就朝徐雅然扑过去，“然然，然然，你这儿子究竟是怎么生出来的，怎么什么都会，二十四孝好儿子啊！”
许静这一早上，听徐雅然说了宁宁的事情，又看宁宁忙前忙后，徐雅然做甩手掌柜，简直嫉妒死了！
“那是，全球独一无二的二十四孝好儿子！”徐雅然挑眉，得意死了，“怎么样，羡慕吧？早点和慕云笙生一个吧，至于……”说着故意顿了顿，“有没有我儿子这么高智商就不知道了，哈哈哈……”
“你居然敢笑我！”许静假装揍她，徐雅然笑嘻嘻，一点都不介意，他家宝贝儿子闺女的高智商，放眼全球也出不了那么一两个啊，结果两个都在他们家了，她当然得意！
两人玩闹了一会儿，许静突然道，“然然，有件事情我想告诉你……”
“嗯？”徐雅然疑惑。
许静顿了良久，沉声道，“陆旭他，一直在找你……”
徐雅然呼吸一置，时隔六年再听到这个名字，她没想到自己还是有些难过的。想想也是，他们是娃娃亲，她从小就认定陆旭是自己的另一半，谁知发生了这种事。
见徐雅然不说话，许静又道，“他至今还未婚，若你……”
“我们已经过去了，不可能了！”徐雅然打算她，“不要再说了！”
“然然，我想你明白，唐氏的事情已经过去了，我这次求你回来参加我的婚礼，不止是想让你看见我很幸福，我也想你幸福，明白吗？”
“我很幸福，我现在有儿子有女儿，不需要其他的了！”徐雅然对自己现在的生活很满足，而陆旭，她在六年前就对他没有了期待。
许静无奈，她是真心的，希望她能够幸福。
徐雅然工作很忙，又是千金大小姐出身，不懂得照顾自己，通常是宁宁照顾她们母女俩，所以宁宁在回A市前就已经在信息库里把A市摸清楚了，当然知道许静家附近的小超市在哪，所以徐雅然也不担心她们。
欢欢和宁宁来到超市，宁宁拿篮，欢欢购物，两人不一会儿就把要用的食材买完了。
宁宁和欢欢在收银员诧异的目光下刷完卡，提了东西就离开了超市。
宁宁提着大袋，欢欢提着小袋，宁宁有些不忍，“欢欢，把袋子给我吧，这么点东西，哥哥提得动，你身体不好，小心摔了！”

欢欢不乐意，“哥哥，不许老拿我的身体说事儿，我很健康，没事问题，我要帮哥哥提东西嘛！”
宁宁坳不过她，只得让她提着。
欢欢蹦蹦跳跳的，十分开心，刚转了一个圈，结果从身后突然快步走上前来一个女人，正好把欢欢撞到在地。
“欢欢！”宁宁立即冲上前去搂住欢欢，“你怎么样了？有没有事？”
欢欢摇头，倒没什么事，只是手上蹭破了皮，有点痛痛的。
宁宁有些心痛，目光看向刚刚撞欢欢的女人，不动声色眯起眼睛，眼里闪过一丝阴狠。
只想快点见到夜爵，慕芷芜哪里有空回头看欢欢一眼，而夜爵这时候正好从大楼出来。
慕芷芜一看见夜爵便迎了上去，忙道歉，“爵，对不起，我来晚了，对不起！”
夜爵不说话，眸光冷冽如冰，静儿的看着面前身穿gucci紫色洋装，脚踩水晶高跟鞋的慕芷芜。
慕芷芜被他看得心发虚，忙撒娇道，“对不起嘛，爵，路上出了点事，我也不想……”
夜爵面无表情，“下不为例！”
得到夜爵的原谅，慕芷芜松了一口气，身为夜爵的未婚妻，和他在一起六年，慕芷芜还是琢磨不透夜爵的性情，生怕他生气。
宁宁将欢欢扶起来，拉着她就想走过去要慕芷芜道歉，欢欢忙阻止他，在他耳边咬耳朵，“哥哥，看见那个男人脖子上的项链没？”
宁宁顺着欢欢的话看过去，夜爵正斜侧着身子，他看不清夜爵的脸，却可以看到他脖子上那条链子！
宁宁顿时眼前一亮，这个男人脖子上的链子像及了他们的死对头——夜门领导人黑杰克的专属项链，黑曜之心！

Hearing the shrimp steamed eggs, Huanhuan's eyes suddenly lit up and her mood became better, "Brother, you have to make shrimp steamed eggs for me for the rest of my life."
"Okay!"
After breakfast, Ning Ning washed the dishes, tidied up the kitchen, and cleaned the entire house, then went out shopping with Huanhuan. Xu Jing hasn't been to the supermarket for a week. The refrigerator is very clean, which makes Ning Ning disgusted.
As soon as Ning Ning and Huan Huan went out, Xu Jing rushed towards Xu Yaran, "Ran Ran, Ran Ran, how on earth was your son born? How come you can do everything? What a good son with twenty-four filial piety!"
Xu Jing heard Xu Yaran talk about Ning Ning's affairs this morning, and saw Ning Ning busy and busy, Xu Yaran was the boss, and she was so jealous!
"That is the only good son with twenty-four filial piety in the world!" Xu Yaran raised her eyebrows and was extremely proud, "How about it, are you envious? Let's have a child with Mu Yunsheng as soon as possible. As for..." He paused deliberately, "I don't know if my son has such a high IQ, hahaha..."
"How dare you laugh at me!" Xu Jing pretended to beat her up, Xu Yaran smiled and didn't mind at all. His precious son and daughter had such high IQs that only one or two of them could be found in the world. In the end, both of them were in their home. Of course she was proud of it!
The two played around for a while, and Xu Jing suddenly said, "Of course, there is something I want to tell you..."
"Huh?" Xu Yaran was confused.
Xu Jing paused for a long time and said in a deep voice, "Lu Xu has been looking for you..."
Xu Yaran took a breath. She heard this name again after six years. She didn't expect that she was still a little sad. Thinking about it, they were childhood relatives. She had believed that Lu Xu was her significant other since she was a child. Who knew that this kind of thing would happen.
Seeing that Xu Yaran didn't speak, Xu Jing added, "He is still unmarried. If you..."
"We've already passed, it's impossible!" Xu Yaran said to her, "Stop talking!"
"Of course, I want you to understand that the Tang syndrome incident is over. I am asking you to come back to attend my wedding this time. Not only do I want you to see that I am happy, I also want you to be happy. Do you understand?"
"I am very happy. I now have a son and a daughter. I don't need anything else!" Xu Yaran is very satisfied with her current life, but for Lu Xu, she had no expectations for him six years ago.
Xu Jing is helpless, she sincerely hopes that she can be happy.
Xu Yaran is very busy at work, and she is a rich young lady, so she does not know how to take care of herself. Usually Ning Ning takes care of the mother and daughter, so Ning Ning has already found out about City A in the information database before returning to City A. Of course, she knows where the small supermarket near Xu Jing's home is, so Xu Yaran is not worried about them.
Huanhuan and Ningning came to the supermarket. Ningning took a basket and Huanhuan did some shopping. The two of them finished buying the ingredients in a short time.
Ningning and Huanhuan swiped their cards under the surprised look of the cashier, picked up their things and left the supermarket.
Ningning was holding the big bag, and Huanhuan was holding the small bag. Ningning couldn't bear it, "Huanhuan, give me the bag. My brother can carry such a small thing. You are not in good health, so be careful if you drop it!"
Huanhuan was unhappy, "Brother, don't always make excuses about my body. I'm healthy and fine. I have to help brother carry things!"
Ning Ning'ao couldn't hold it back, so she had to let her carry it.
Huan Huan was jumping up and down, very happy, and just turned around in a circle, when a woman suddenly walked up from behind and knocked Huan Huan to the ground.
"Huanhuan!" Ning Ning immediately rushed forward and hugged Huanhuan, "How are you? Are you okay?"
Huanhuan shook his head. Nothing happened, but the skin on his hand was scratched and it hurt a little.
Ning Ning felt a little heartbroken and looked at the woman who had just bumped into Huanhuan. She narrowed her eyes calmly, with a trace of evil flashing in her eyes.
Mu Zhiwu just wanted to see Ye Jue quickly, so Mu Zhiwu had no time to look back at Huanhuan, and Ye Jue happened to come out of the building at this time.
As soon as Mu Zhiwu saw Ye Jue, he greeted himGo and apologize, "Jue, I'm sorry, I'm late, I'm sorry!"
Ye Jue didn't speak, his eyes were as cold as ice. Jing'er looked at Mu Zhiwu who was wearing a Gucci purple dress and crystal high heels in front of her.
Mu Zhiwu felt guilty when he saw him, and said coquettishly, "I'm sorry, Jue, something happened on the road, and I didn't want to..."
Ye Jue's face was expressionless, "I won't do this again!"
Mu Zhiwu breathed a sigh of relief after receiving Ye Jue's forgiveness. As Ye Jue's fiancée, after being with him for six years, Mu Zhiwu still couldn't figure out Ye Jue's temperament, for fear that he would be angry.
Ning Ning helped Huanhuan up, pulled her and wanted to walk over to ask Mu Zhiwu to apologize. Huanhuan quickly stopped him and bit his ear, "Brother, have you seen the necklace around that man's neck?"
Ning Ning followed Huanhuan's words and looked over. Ye Jue was leaning sideways. He couldn't see Ye Jue's face clearly, but he could see the chain around his neck!
Ning Ning's eyes suddenly lit up. The chain around this man's neck looked like the exclusive necklace of their sworn enemy, Black Jack, the leader of the Night Gate, the Heart of Obsidian!
